# CG-REQ-009: Request parameter serialization changed

The effective style, explode, allowReserved or content media type of a parameter changed.

**Why it matters:** Serialization defines the bytes on the wire.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Detects | `parameter.serializationChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Serialization of {where} changed ({fields}).
>
> Consumers encode the value the old way (for example `a=1&a=2` vs `a=1,2`); the provider may misread it.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the previous serialization, or accept both encodings.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: array explode true → false

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: ids, in: query, schema: {type: array, items: {type: string}}}]
+       parameters: [{name: ids, in: query, explode: false, schema: {type: array, items: {type: string}}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Serialization of GET /x: query parameter "ids" changed (explode).

### Fires: style form → spaceDelimited

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: ids, in: query, schema: {type: array, items: {type: string}}}]
+       parameters: [{name: ids, in: query, style: spaceDelimited, schema: {type: array, items: {type: string}}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Serialization of GET /x: query parameter "ids" changed (style, explode).

### Does not fire: absent style → explicit default

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: ids, in: query, schema: {type: array, items: {type: string}}}]
+       parameters: [{name: ids, in: query, style: form, explode: true, schema: {type: array, items: {type: string}}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: explode on a primitive

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: q, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
+       parameters: [{name: q, in: query, explode: false, schema: {type: string}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- For primitive values, explode has no effect; such changes are suppressed.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml

  ignore:

      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:

```
